issues.where: crops F and G, coronal arcade
issues.what: mid-size filament strands soften and blend, past finest-grain loss, though the arcade still has form
issues.fix: keep more mid-frequency contrast on the bright arcade so strand separation survives the stress encode

issues.where: Encoded crops E, H, and I, along the dark canyon and adjacent ridges
issues.what: Angular compression patches break up the canyon shadows and merge distinct ridge faces into soft chunks. This changes recognizable terrain shapes, not just the finest grain.
issues.fix: Give this Mars close-up more bits and lower quantization in the canyon shadows, then check crops E, H, and I at native size again.

issues.where: Encoded crops B, C, and D, in the dust haze and around the crater rims
issues.what: Smooth orange haze turns into broad, partly squared-off tonal patches, visible around the bright filament in C and in the darker crater surround in D.
issues.fix: Reduce quantization in the smooth haze and shadow gradients; keep intermediate processing at higher bit depth and check for patch boundaries after the stress encode.

issues.where: Encoded crops D, H, and I, in the dusty lowlands and canyon shadow
issues.what: Low-contrast terrain shading is flattened and slightly patchy compared with the original, though the main canyon and craters remain legible.
issues.fix: Preserve low-contrast shading with a lower quantizer in the Mars shots, without spending bits on the finest grain.

issues.where: crops A (848,434) and E (1328,704), sparse dark star field
issues.what: on the encoded side a clear share of the faint stars are gone and the remaining ones are dimmer and softer, so the empty sky looks thinner than the source; the same loss shows in image-22 and image-24
issues.fix: lower CRF / raise the bitrate floor for dark low-motion frames, use -tune grain or turn on psy-rd/aq-mode 3 so single-pixel stars are not quantized away, or render the stars as slightly larger 2-3 px points

issues.where: crops A, G and E, the eroded plateau texture and bright slope
issues.what: the fine ridges smear into soft blobs and the cliff edges in E pick up a smeary, slightly blocky look, so the surface reads less crisp than the source (still readable, not mush)
issues.fix: give more bits to high-detail motion frames (raise maxrate/bufsize or use a two-pass encode) and turn on aq-mode 3 to keep texture

issues.where: crop C (1328,164), haze over the dark basin
issues.what: the soft haze gradient loses a little tonal smoothness and shows faint macroblock edges
issues.fix: encode in 10-bit or add a light dither or grain to the haze before encoding

issues.where: crops B, C, F, G, Milky Way dust lanes
issues.what: the nebula texture flattens slightly and loses some star-dust grain; no hard blocking
issues.fix: acceptable at this bitrate; optionally use -tune grain

issues.what: the three planet stills look like the same frame, so the planet shot is checked at only one moment; no banding seen in the rim glow or dark planet disc
issues.fix: pull stills from several different times in the stress encode, including a high-motion moment
